aria: Animated recap of the Rockets' 110 to 100 home win over Denver: Alperen Şengün's reverse layup with 4:14 left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Kevin Durant's 23 points, 12 rebounds and 8 assists, the top scorers, how the Rockets won, and the next game against Golden State.
notes: Box score from the Rockets' 110–100 home win over the Denver Nuggets on Nov 9, 2026, from Covers.com's game overview (quarter scores, every player's line, rebounds, assists, threes, blocks, free throws and biggest leads). All 110 Rockets points and all 100 Nuggets points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals. Game details from the AP (Kristie Rieken, via ABC News), Field Level Media (via Yardbarker), Heavy (via Yahoo Sports), Rockets On SI, The Denver Gazette, Denver Stiffs and Ball Exclusives (via Yardbarker). The sports data feed wasn't available for this recap.

Halftime was 54–40 (Denver Gazette, Denver Stiffs). Biggest leads: Houston's 19 and Denver's 2 (Covers.com). Denver's 18–2 run erased a 58–42 lead and tied it 60–60 with 5:04 left in the third (Field Level Media, AP); Houston led 77–68 after three. Durant's 12 rebounds and 8 assists were season highs, he made all 10 free throws, and he scored 11 in the first quarter (Heavy, Rockets On SI). Houston had 29 assists on 41 baskets and won bench points 33–22 (Heavy, Rockets On SI; bench points also add up from the box score). The win snapped a two-game skid (AP). Jamal Murray's 38 was his fourth game of 34 or more this season (AP). The Rockets are 8–3 and sixth in the West, and host Golden State on Wednesday at 9:30 PM ET (Ball Exclusives; AP says Wednesday night). The Warriors' 8–3 is their 7–3 in the site's standings plus Monday's win over New Orleans.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Alperen Şengün's reverse baseline layup around Nikola Jokić that gave the Rockets a 98–90 lead with 4:14 left (Denver Stiffs). Just before it, Jamal Murray's two free throws had cut the lead to six (AP), and Şengün's basket and an Amen Thompson basket then made it 100–90 with four minutes left (AP). It is drawn as a plain close-range finish; the reverse itself isn't animated. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Houston Rockets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Şengün’s listed 6-foot-11 and 243 pounds (RealGM), wearing No. 28 (RealGM), with arms scaled to the 7-foot wingspan reported by SportsBrief, in the Rockets' home kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
